title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for S, ensuring it meets the specified condition.

title: Flatness Measurement
description: Important Criteria: The student should describe the method of using Newton's rings to measure the flatness of the glass surface.

title: Parallelism Measurement
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain how to measure the parallelism of the glass surfaces using interference fringes.

title: Wedge Angle Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the relationship between wedge angle and spacing in the context of the problem.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the wavelength.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or alternative methods for verifying the specifications.
